verdict.rationale: The only delegation evidence is a single Patent Center note: sponsored support staff can prepare and save an AIR Form, which the Corresponding Practitioner can then access. That shows a published support-staff role acting on a practitioner's behalf, but nothing sets out the full scope of what third parties may or may not do. Missing for 10: published authorization or power-of-attorney forms, a complete definition of delegate roles and their permissions, rules on which signatures or submissions must stay personal to the practitioner or applicant, trademark-side delegation rules, and independent corroboration.
